properties.description: Phase 1 assignment of the SecOps tagging initiative at subscription scope. Audit/deny policies start at Audit; the data-classification inherit (Modify) starts Disabled. Phase 2: set inheritEffect=Modify and run remediation. Phase 3: set auditDenyEffect=Deny (target Prod). A system-assigned identity is included so the Modify policy can be enabled without re-creating the assignment.

nonComplianceMessages.message: This resource is missing/invalid 'data classification', lacks 'compliance' on restricted data, or violates a classification-driven security control. See the SecOps tagging standard.
